activity.notes: Dzhokhar Dudayev won the Chechen presidential election held on 27 October 1991 and on 1 November issued the decree restoring Chechen state independence. ATLAS uses 1 November 1991 as the start of his presidency of the self-proclaimed Chechen Republic of Ichkeria and records his term through his death on 21 April 1996. The polity label records the de facto separatist political community without implying international recognition.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria — History
sources.citation_text: The chronology records the 27 October 1991 presidential election won by Dzhokhar Dudayev and his 1 November independence decree.
